title: I Took the Pool-Locker Pin to the Desk That Issued Two to Friends

parts.text: I typed my locker pin at 6:18 a.m. and it opened a locker with someone else's shoes. Desk lead Mara had issued my numbered pin to a friend in May. I was twenty-five, masters swimmer, holding a receipt that listed locker 44. I photographed the shoes, the receipt, and the pin pad. Then I took the pin to the desk. At 6:26 the manager pinged a duplicate issue. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. Mara rekeyed 44. Policy now has a second line: PINS ARE NOT FRIENDSHIP. I keep the receipt. The locker finally looks like a number, not a favor.
